rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose expression for the physical act of winking with one eye.

example.english: They gave the camera a wink, making everyone laugh.
example.traditional: 佢對住鏡頭眨吓眼，搞到大家笑晒。
example.jyutping: keoi5 deoi3 zyu6 geng3 tau4 zaam2 haa5 ngaan5 gaau2 dou3 daai6 gaa1 siu3 saai3

rows.note: Use this when the wink is meant as a nonverbal signal or message to someone.

example.english: The boss gave me a wink to tell me to keep quiet.
example.traditional: 老闆畀咗我一個眼色，叫我收聲。
example.jyutping: lou5 baan2 bei2 zo2 ngo5 jat1 go3 ngaan5 sik1 giu3 ngo5 sau1 seng1

rows.note: Use this for a brief nap or short period of sleep, not an eye gesture.

example.english: I need a quick wink of sleep after lunch so I can get back to work.
example.traditional: 我食完飯想瞓一陣，先有精神做嘢。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sik6 jyun4 faan6 soeng2 fan3 jat1 zan6 sin1 jau5 zing1 san4 zou6 je5
